evd_title: OpenReviewer won against GPT-4o in 60% and against Llama-3.1-70B in 76% of LLM-as-judge preference evaluations
finding: OpenReviewer won against GPT-4o in 60% and against Llama-3.1-70B in 76% of LLM-as-judge preference evaluations
P: 400 held-out NeurIPS 2024 + ICLR 2025 papers; 1600 pairwise judgments
I: OpenReviewer (fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B); judged by GPT-4o (2024-11-20) vs human expert reviews
O: OpenReviewer win rate: vs GPT-4o 60%, Claude 69%, Llama-8B 70%, Llama-70B 76%
